description.value: The GG-OS frames were designed for military and corporate espionage applications, yet cyborgs in the seedier parts of society naturally gravitate to these builds as well. A few of these cyborgs find their way into athletic competitions. Your augmentations are sleek and subtle, and your frame is inherently faster than most other frames due to the lightweight materials used in its construction. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Fleet] general feat.
